name: China Satellite Communications Co., Ltd.
summary: China Satellite Communications Co., Ltd. provides satellite communications and broadcasting services. It offers business support platforms, including visualized platform to support design, simulation, and evaluation on satellite resources and satellite application; multi-satellite unified tracking, telemetry, and control (TT&C) platform; traditional beam comprehensive service; carrier grade satellite broadband business and operation infrastructure platform; and satellite application platforms for airborne, maritime, emergency response, and universal services.
